name: competitor-teardown
description: Competitor Teardown: compare your product with competitors from public pages and review sites; get a sourced matrix, strategy canvas, ERRC, positioning map and prioritized moves.

plugins.name: competitor-teardown
plugins.description: Tear down up to 5 competitors through 12 lenses (positioning, buyer, breadth, pricing, proof, comparison pages, onboarding, integrations, reviews, SEO footprint, hiring and funding, changes over time); every cell cites a dated source. Outputs a render-checked HTML report and a hands-off brief for AI agents.
